topics.topic: Authority source when resuming service_unreachable draft-write operations
questions: When resuming a `service_unreachable` operation element of class `draft-write` (that is not a resend after `not_applied`), is authority the run's pinned FlowActivation (as A14/A10 state), or must resume look for approval/grant only as this step says?

topics.topic: Immediate process/run state when post-send store-write fails
questions: If the send already happened but the second store call fails, what must happen to process/run state immediately (before any restart)?

topics.topic: Ownership of emitting external unknown-reference refusal
questions: Which module must emit the external unknown-reference refusal: surface, or the record-owning module?

topics.topic: Scope of checks to re-run on accept_binding
questions: On accept_binding, must the kernel re-run all A08 rule 5 checks (including instance checks), or only the send-time stale/record checks of rule 6?
